name: SilentTyping

settings.label: Enabled globally
settings.description: Toggle functionality of your own typing indicator globally.

settings.label: Hide chat bar typing indicators
settings.description: Hide other users' typing indicators from above the chat bar.

settings.label: Hide members list typing indicators
settings.description: Hide other users' typing indicators from the members list.

settings.label: Chat icon
settings.description: Show an icon in the chat bar for modifying the plugin on the go.

settings.label: Left click action
settings.description: What to do when left clicking the chat icon.

settings.label: Middle click action
settings.description: What to do when middle clicking the chat icon.

settings.label: Right click action
settings.description: What to do when right clicking the chat icon.

settings.label: Chat context menu
settings.description: Show a dropdown in the chat context menu to modify plugin settings on the go.

settings.label: Default hidden
settings.description: If enabled, the plugin will hide your typing from others in any DMs/channels/guilds not listed in "Disabled Locations" below. If disabled, the plugin will show your typing to others for any DMs/channels/guilds not listed in "Enabled Locations" below.

settings.label: Always enable in active voice chat
settings.description: Always allow your typing indicator to show when typing in a voice channel you are connected to.

settings.label: Temporary enable threshold (servers)
settings.description: Temporarily allow your typing indicator to show for this many seconds after sending a message in a server channel. If the typing indicator is already visible in the channel, this setting will have no effect.

settings.label: Temporary enable threshold (DMs)
settings.description: Temporarily allow your typing indicator to show for this many seconds after sending a message in a DM or Group DM. If the typing indicator is already visible in the channel, this setting will have no effect.

settings.label: Enabled locations
settings.description: Enable functionality for these IDs. Accepts a comma separated list of DM IDs, channel IDs, and guild IDs. Only used if "Default Hidden" is disabled.

settings.label: Disabled locations
settings.description: Disable functionality for these IDs. Accepts a comma separated list of DM IDs, channel IDs, and guild IDs. Only used if "Default Hidden" is enabled.

gaps: The /silent-typing command: Qord has no slash commands yet.
The "Silent Typing" submenu in the message box's right-click menu: the message box has no plugin menu surface yet.
"Hide members list typing indicators" has nothing to hide: Qord's member list does not show who is typing.
notes: Qord sends Discord's typing indicator like the official client (about once every 9 seconds while you type); this plugin decides per channel whether it goes out.
